events.text:
## Recommendation
- **Go to St. Joseph** for boat fishing. My rating: **3 (good)**.
- **South Haven is a close second**, also **3 (good)**.
- **Grand Haven: 1 (below average)**. Its only boat report is two weeks old and rated coho-only.
- **Muskegon: 1 (below average)**. Its latest boat report was mixed and hit-or-miss.
- At St. Joseph, run small crankbaits about 20-30 ft down for coho, and spoons or small crankbaits around 50-60 ft for spring Chinook.

## Why
- St. Joseph and South Haven both had boat reports rated good in the most recent bulletin, while Grand Haven and Muskegon were rated below average.
- The St. Joseph report found coho in 20-30 ft on small crankbaits and Chinook at 50-60 ft, which matches the depths I'd expect a boater to target this week.
- I'd expect St. Joseph to be the better bet of the two good ports because its boat fishing rated good for both coho and Chinook, while South Haven's mix was more varied.

## Evidence
**Recent reports**
- St. Joseph, Apr 30: coho boat fishing rated 3 (good) in 20-30 ft, with "small crankbaits trolled" working best. Chinook boat fishing rated 3 at 50-60 ft, described as "beginning to have some good success targeting spring Chinook." (St. Joseph, 2025-04-30)
- South Haven, Apr 30: boat fishing rated 3 (good) in 45-60 ft, with a mixed bag of coho and Chinook. "Small crankbaits and spoons were catching most of the fish." (South Haven, 2025-04-30)
- South Haven, Apr 23: boat coho rated 3 (good) in about 20 ft, and Chinook rated 1 at 50 ft. (South Haven, 2025-04-23)
- Muskegon, Apr 30: boat fishing rated 1 (below average), with a "mixed bag" of Chinook, brown trout and lake trout. Anglers said it was "hit or miss," but those who found fish did well. (Muskegon, 2025-04-30)
- Grand Haven, Apr 23: the only boat entry was a coho rating of 1 (below average), with "a few" fish caught near shore. (Grand Haven, 2025-04-23)

**Past seasons (history, not current)**
- In past early-May weeks with similar surface water (about 47 F), boat anglers mostly caught Chinook on spoons, typically at 30-80 ft. Ratings ranged from 1 to 3. (2023-05-03 and 2024-05-01, several ports)
- In 2022, the same weeks were often rated 1 for kings. (2022-05-04, St. Joseph and South Haven)

**Conditions now**
- The conditions tool returned a backtest summary for the week before today, not live data. The buoy surface water was about 50 F at St. Joseph (-2 F over the week), 47 F at South Haven (-7 F), and 45 F at Grand Haven and Muskegon (+2 F each). (Conditions summary, week before 2025-05-06)
- South Haven's 7 F drop is a sign of upwelling. The week also had 70 hours of north-to-east wind at 8+ mph there. (South Haven, conditions summary)
- I have no wind forecast for this coming week, so I can't say whether conditions will hold.

## Caveats
- The newest reports are from April 30, six days old. Grand Haven's is 13 days old. Spring conditions change fast, so treat these as a guide.
- The water temperatures above are measured buoy values from the backtest summary, not live readings. The lake may have moved since.
- Boat reports this spring are thin: only one or two per port, and several are rated 1. Ratings of 3 rest on one report per species at St. Joseph and South Haven.
- Before you go, check the wind forecast. Strong north or east winds would both help upwelling and make a small boat unsafe.
